products.name: Essential Black Tee
products.description: A clean black crew-neck tee in heavyweight 220 gsm cotton. Regular fit that layers well under shirts and jackets. Machine wash cold inside out to keep the colour deep.

products.name: Graphic Print Tee
products.description: A relaxed-fit cotton tee with a bold front print. Dropped shoulders and a slightly longer body give it an easy street look. Wash inside out, do not iron the print.

products.name: Classic Denim Jacket
products.description: A classic trucker jacket in rigid 13 oz denim with button chest pockets and adjustable waist tabs. It softens and fades with every wear. Machine wash cold, line dry.

products.name: Leather Biker Jacket
products.description: An asymmetric biker jacket in soft lamb leather with a quilted lining, zip cuffs and a snap collar. Built to break in and last for years. Professional leather clean only.

products.name: Bomber Jacket
products.description: A lightweight nylon bomber with a padded body, ribbed collar, cuffs and hem, and a utility sleeve pocket. Water-repellent finish for changing weather. Machine wash cold.

products.name: Puffer Jacket
products.description: A warm puffer jacket with recycled synthetic fill, a stand collar and an adjustable hood. Packs into its own pocket for travel. Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle.

products.name: Windbreaker Jacket
products.description: A packable windbreaker in ripstop nylon with a half zip, drawcord hood and elastic cuffs. Blocks wind on cool mornings and folds into a small pouch. Machine wash cold.

products.name: Corduroy Jacket
products.description: A corduroy trucker jacket in soft 8-wale cotton with a sherpa-lined collar and two chest pockets. A warm middle layer for autumn days. Machine wash cold, reshape while damp.

products.name: Varsity Jacket
products.description: A varsity jacket with a wool-blend body, contrast sleeves, snap front and striped rib trims. A college classic with a modern regular fit. Dry clean recommended.

products.name: Fleece Jacket
products.description: A cosy fleece jacket in brushed recycled polyester with a full zip, zip hand pockets and a stand collar. Light, warm and quick to dry. Machine wash cold.

products.name: Rain Jacket
products.description: A waterproof rain jacket with taped seams, an adjustable hood and underarm vents. Keeps you dry on rainy commutes without feeling heavy. Machine wash cold, re-proof yearly.

products.name: Suede Jacket
products.description: A suede shirt-jacket with a point collar, snap front and flap chest pockets. Soft, slightly brushed texture that ages beautifully. Professional suede clean only.

products.name: Oxford White Shirt
products.description: A crisp Oxford shirt in breathable cotton with a button-down collar and a tailored fit. Dress it up with a tie or wear it open over a tee. Machine wash warm, iron while damp.

products.name: Flannel Check Shirt
products.description: A brushed flannel shirt in a classic check with a chest pocket and button cuffs. Soft, warm cotton for layering in cooler months. Machine wash cold, tumble dry low.

products.name: Denim Shirt
products.description: A western-style denim shirt in mid-weight cotton with snap buttons and two flap pockets. Wear it as a shirt or as a light overshirt. Machine wash cold.

products.name: Linen Shirt
products.description: A relaxed linen shirt that stays cool and breathable on hot days, with a camp collar and a straight hem. Gets softer with every wash. Machine wash cold, line dry.

products.name: Hawaiian Shirt
products.description: A short-sleeve resort shirt in light viscose with an all-over floral print and an open camp collar. Made for holidays and summer evenings. Hand wash cold.

products.name: Striped Shirt
products.description: A striped cotton poplin shirt with a regular collar and a curved hem. Smart enough for the office, easy enough for weekends. Machine wash warm.

products.name: Black Dress Shirt
products.description: A black dress shirt in easy-iron cotton stretch with a slim fit and a cutaway collar. A sharp choice for evenings and events. Machine wash warm, iron on medium heat.

products.name: Polo Shirt
products.description: A classic polo in breathable cotton piqué with a ribbed collar, two-button placket and side vents. A neat alternative to a tee. Machine wash cold.

products.name: Khaki Work Shirt
products.description: A sturdy work shirt in cotton twill with two button chest pockets and reinforced seams. Wear it alone or as an overshirt. Machine wash warm.

products.name: Henley Shirt
products.description: A long-sleeve henley in soft slub cotton with a three-button placket and ribbed cuffs. A relaxed layer between a tee and a shirt. Machine wash cold.

products.name: Slim Blue Jeans
products.description: Slim jeans in stretch denim that keep their shape all day, with a mid rise and a tapered leg. Five-pocket styling in a classic mid-blue wash. Machine wash cold inside out.

products.name: Black Jeans
products.description: Black jeans in a slim straight cut with comfortable stretch. A colour-fast black that stays dark wash after wash. Machine wash cold inside out.

products.name: Ripped Jeans
products.description: Distressed jeans with ripped knees, light whiskering and a relaxed tapered fit. A worn-in look from the first day. Machine wash cold inside out, line dry.

products.name: Wide-Leg Jeans
products.description: High-rise wide-leg jeans in rigid cotton denim with a full-length leg. A relaxed 90s shape that pairs with crop tops and tucked shirts. Machine wash cold.

products.name: Mom Jeans
products.description: High-waisted mom jeans with a relaxed hip and a tapered ankle in a vintage light wash. Comfortable all-day cotton denim. Machine wash cold.

products.name: Straight Jeans
products.description: Straight jeans with a regular rise and a straight leg from hip to hem. An everyday classic in durable cotton denim. Machine wash cold inside out.

products.name: Light Wash Jeans
products.description: Light wash jeans with a soft vintage fade and a regular straight fit. Easy summer denim that goes with everything. Machine wash cold.

products.name: Flared Jeans
products.description: Flared jeans with a high rise, a fitted thigh and a gentle flare from the knee. A 70s-inspired shape in stretch denim. Machine wash cold inside out.

products.name: Raw Denim Jeans
products.description: Raw selvedge jeans in unwashed 14 oz denim with a straight leg. They mould to your body and fade with your own wear. Wash as rarely as possible, cold and inside out.

products.name: Classic Denim Jeans
products.description: Classic five-pocket jeans in a mid-weight cotton denim with a regular fit. An honest everyday pair that suits any season. Machine wash cold inside out.
